abstract:
Join our free WGCNA webinar on 18 November 2026. Marta Benegas explains co-expression network theory and parameter choice, then runs a full WGCNA workflow with functional enrichment in OmicsBox, no coding needed.

The post Free WGCNA Webinar: Unlocking Complex Gene Networks in OmicsBox appeared first on BioBam.
